mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows audit entries for the same application to share the same timestamp, violating append-only immutability. The AppendOnly assertion checks that all audit entries for the same application have distinct timestamps.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMutation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.application = ae2.application and ae1.timestamp = ae2.timestamp }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows an application's assigned officer to be identical to its applicant. The NoSelfMutation and FR_013_NoSelfApproval assertions check that assigned_officer != applicant, preventing self-approval conflicts.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfAssignment { some app: LoanApplication | app.assigned_officer = app.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows multiple pending/under_review applications per applicant, violating the one-in-flight rule. The assertion checks that each user has at most one in-flight application.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultipleInFlight { some u: User | lone app: LoanApplication | app.applicant = u and (app.status = Pending or app.status = UnderReview) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact leaves the permission matrix undefined, allowing arbitrary role-operation pairs. The assertions check that specific permissions match the expected matrix (auditors cannot PATCH, applicants cannot PATCH, etc.).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionLeak { (Auditor -> PatchStatus) in PermMatrix.Allowed or (Applicant -> PatchStatus) in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows illegal transitions (e.g., pending → approved, or approved → under_review). The assertion enforces the four allowed transitions: none→pending, pending→under_review, under_review→{approved,rejected}.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_IllegalTransition { some ae: AuditEntry | (ae.previous_status = Pending and ae.new_status = Approved) or (ae.previous_status = Approved and ae.new_status = UnderReview) }
